# `silk/writer`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Complete-message standard-output and standard-error writes through a replaceable service.

## When to use

Use [`Writer`](#declaration-73696d6b65723a3a576269) for complete byte messages to stdout or stderr.
Structured logging belongs in `silk.logger`.

## Details

`Writer` is an ordinary source-declared service. Its requirement remains in an
Effect until a caller supplies a provider, so tests and applications can replace the
process-backed implementation lexically. Stream failure is typed as [`WriterError`](#declaration-73696d6b65723a3a5762697465724572726f72).

## Examples

### Write one complete standard-output message

```silk
import silk.effect { Effect }

import silk.writer { Writer }

effect fn writeMessage() -> ()
! Writer.WriterError {
  let mut writer = Writer.stdoutWriterProvider()
  return run Writer.writeAll(b"Silk\n")
    |> Effect.provideMut<Writer>(&mut writer)
}

effect fn ignoreWriteFailure(error: Writer.WriterError) -> () {
  return ()
}

pub fn main() -> i32 {
  let completed = run Effect.catchAll(writeMessage(), ignoreWriteFailure)
  return 42
}
```

Import as `Writer` with `import silk.writer { Writer }`.
